editorial: Today, high-performance CPU architectures and efficiency optimizations for large language models are at the forefront of the technology agenda. On the hardware side, Xiaomi's new processor data is drawing attention, while in the software world, intensive academic studies have been published on content management and long-workflow evaluation metrics.

items.title: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.summary: Awesome-gpt-image-2 is a library that adopts a 'prompt as code' approach for image generation models. With over 530 reverse-engineered examples and more than 20 industrial templates, it offers standard skills for AI visualization processes.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.summary: Claude Plugins Community, shared by Anthropic, brings together community plugins developed for the AI assistants Claude Cowork and Claude Code. This directory allows users to expand the capabilities of AI tools by sharing the plugins they have written themselves.

items.title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
items.summary: Developed by MadsLorentzen, ai-job-search is a local AI job search framework that evaluates job postings, customizes CVs, and prepares cover letters. Using the Claude Code infrastructure, this Python-based tool allows users to automate their job application processes on their own computers.

items.title: apache/maka
items.summary: Apache Maka is a workspace for AI agents where data is kept in a local-first structure. It makes process tracking transparent by recording messages, tool calls, and permission decisions only in an append-only log format.

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
items.summary: TradingAgents is a multi-agent-based Python framework designed for trading in financial markets. It provides an infrastructure that analyzes market data and develops automated trading strategies using large language models.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.summary: Claude-obsidian is a tool that runs on the note-taking application Obsidian and provides AI-powered personal knowledge management. Integrated with Claude Code, it analyzes data, establishes connections, and transforms them into an organized knowledge graph, offering an open-source alternative to platforms like Notion.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: Prepared for those new to the field of AI engineering, this resource teaches application development and deployment processes from the ground up using the Python language. Combining theoretical knowledge with practical projects, the content enables users to build their own AI-based products from end to end.

items.title: tinyhumansai/openhuman
items.summary: OpenHuman is an AI-based personal assistant that creates a user-specific memory by storing personal data on the local device. Developed in Rust, this tool coordinates AI agents that manage complex workflows and conducts in-depth research processes.

items.title: basecamp/omarchy
items.summary: Omarchy, developed by Basecamp, is a tool that offers a modern and unique configuration experience for Linux operating systems. Used to manage system settings, this software aims to standardize users' operating system preferences.

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.summary: Awesome-llm-apps is an open-source Python library containing over a hundred AI agents, skill packages, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications. It facilitates the creation of AI-based workflows by providing free and ready-to-use code examples that developers can use in their own projects.

items.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
items.summary: Based on Andrej Karpathy's observations regarding errors in coding processes with large language models (LLMs), this file aims to optimize the performance of the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code. Developers can improve the AI's coding habits by using the CLAUDE.md configuration file.

items.title: openai/codex
items.summary: Codex, written in the Rust language, is a lightweight coding agent that runs on the terminal. It provides direct interactive support via the command line to accelerate software development processes.

items.title: marin-community/marin
items.summary: Marin is an open-source Python framework designed for the research and development of foundation models. It aims to simplify the processes of training and optimizing large-scale artificial intelligence models.

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.summary: Ponytail is a JavaScript tool that prevents unnecessary workload by minimizing the coding process for artificial intelligence agents. Adopting the philosophy that the best code in software development processes is the code that is never written, it enables agents to produce solutions with less code.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: Claude Plugins, shared by Anthropic, offer an official directory that expands the capabilities of the AI-powered coding tool Claude Code. These Python-based plugins allow developers to automate and customize their software development processes.

items.title: asciimoo/hister
items.summary: Hister is a personal search engine infrastructure developed with the Go programming language. It allows users to create their own indexes and perform independent searches on the web.

items.title: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs
items.summary: The new product safety and compliance regulations enacted by the European Union are creating heavy costs for small-scale hardware manufacturers and micro-entrepreneurs. These strict bureaucratic processes make it difficult for individual designers and small businesses to continue their operations, thereby restricting competition in the market.

items.title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded
items.summary: The new processor cores developed by Xiaomi reach levels similar to Apple processors in terms of single-core performance while offering higher speeds in multi-core performance. This development shows that competition in the smartphone processor market has entered a new phase at the hardware architecture level.

items.title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID
items.summary: Microsoft Paint and the Photos app add invisible digital watermarks containing a globally unique identifier (GUID) to locally generated images. This method functions as a tracking mechanism used to trace the origin and editing history of images.

items.title: iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses will remain on icloud.com
items.summary: Apple has announced that it will continue to limit the addresses generated by the Hide My Email feature to the icloud.com domain. This decision mandates that hidden email addresses created by users via custom domains must be managed through the existing infrastructure.

items.title: The entire city of San Francisco as a video game
items.summary: This project, which turns the entire city of San Francisco into a browser-based video game, transfers geographic data into an interactive digital world. Users can explore urban areas with game mechanics on this platform where they can navigate the city map.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen2.5-27B, developed by Alibaba, is a multimodal large language model capable of processing text and visual data. Offered with open weights, this model demonstrates high performance in complex reasoning and content analysis processes.

items.title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
items.summary: Unsloth is an optimization library focused on training large language models faster and with lower memory usage. This version of the Qwen2.5-27B model is offered in GGUF format, which facilitates running it on local devices and reduces hardware requirements.

items.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX, which has visual and text-based input processing capabilities, stands out as an uncensored large language model. Optimized to run efficiently on Apple devices, this model analyzes image and text data to produce text-based outputs.

items.title: OBLITERATUS/Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED is a text-generation model shared on HuggingFace, a platform that hosts open-source artificial intelligence models. The model offers a structure with security restrictions removed, allowing users to generate less filtered content.

items.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8 is a multimodal AI model that processes visual and text-based data to generate responses. The model operates using less memory through the low-precision computation (FP8) method, which compresses weight values.

items.title: The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search
items.summary: A new method has been developed for the efficient management of context budgets and the measurement of evidence usage in generative search processes. This study presents a causal analysis approach that improves the knowledge-based generation performance of artificial intelligence by correcting errors in existing relevance metrics.

items.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
items.summary: LongWoF-Bench is a new benchmarking tool that evaluates the constraints and verification processes encountered by large language models in complex workflows. Using a method called EvoMap, it aims to prevent models from repeating the same errors by externalizing previously verified successful processing paths.

items.title: AutoResearch: Insight In, Hallucination Out
items.summary: AutoResearch aims to ensure scientific consistency in autonomous research processes by combining idea generation and experimental implementation stages. The system targets minimizing the hallucination problem in artificial intelligence models by using continuously updated research data.

items.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
items.summary: Compression and quantization processes lead to performance loss in the reasoning and coding capabilities of large language models. The quantization-aware healing method offers a new process that allows these models to regain their original capabilities before deployment.

items.title: EXPL-FR: Explaining Face Recognition Models via Vision-Language Alignment
items.summary: EXPL-FR provides a method that makes the decision-making processes of deep face recognition models transparent. This lightweight adapter, which aligns the face recognition space with a vision-language model, makes it possible to explain which semantic features the system relies on to assign a similarity score through text-based queries.

items.title: I cannot survive from burnout
items.summary: Burnout syndrome experienced by software developers makes it difficult to maintain work-focused productivity, negatively affecting both the professional and personal lives of individuals. The conflict between the desire to engage in personal projects and mandatory work discipline creates a serious obstacle, especially during long-term recovery processes.

items.title: MNT Station - A modular, open hardware desktop computer and server
items.summary: MNT Station is a modular and open-source desktop computer and server platform where users can freely change hardware components. Focusing on hardware design transparency, this system offers a flexible computing environment that users can configure according to their own needs.

items.title: An interactive introduction to the spanning tree protocol
items.summary: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is a mechanism that manages network traffic in redundant connections by preventing network switches from creating loops. This interactive guide, prepared by Vincent Bernat, explains the working logic of the protocol step-by-step with visualizations.

glossary.explanation: Versioning and storing prompts given to artificial intelligence in an organized manner, similar to software code.
Special abilities or tools that artificial intelligence models use to perform a specific task.
Small utility programs used to extend the existing features of software or add new functionality to it.
Technology that enables computers to understand objects or situations within digital images and videos by analyzing them.
A software approach that prioritizes storing and managing data directly on the user's own device without the need for the internet.
A secure ledger where old data cannot be altered, and only new information can be appended to the end.
The collaboration of multiple artificial intelligence units that communicate with each other to share a complex task.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A method of systematically storing and retrieving information, ideas, and notes learned by an individual using digital tools.
The process of designing and developing systems that produce solutions to real-world problems using artificial intelligence models.
Autonomous software that makes its own decisions and performs tasks by using various tools to reach a goal.
An intelligent software unit capable of perceiving its environment and taking action based on its own decisions toward a specific goal.
A method that allows artificial intelligence to retrieve information from external, up-to-date documents instead of its own memory when generating answers.
An advanced artificial intelligence model capable of forming natural, human-like sentences by processing massive amounts of text data.
An artificial intelligence that can understand tasks given by a programmer, write code on its own, debug, and develop projects.
Foundation artificial intelligence models trained on very large datasets, upon which many different applications can be developed.
